title: AI Powered Bird Frame
description:
This AI-powered bird identification frame might be one of my favorite uses of artificial intelligence.

It listens to the birds outside your window, identifies each species by its call, and gradually creates a live visual record of the wildlife around your home.

The project uses a small microphone and a Raspberry Pi running BirdNET, an AI model trained to recognize birds through sound. When it detects a new visitor, an AI image generator creates an illustration of that bird and adds it to the frame.

What makes this so interesting is that most of us probably hear dozens of bird calls without ever knowing what we're listening to. This frame turns those background sounds into something visible, giving you a better sense of just how much wildlife is passing through your neighborhood every day.

It's a perfect example of how AI can do more than make us productive. It can also help us slow down, pay attention, and appreciate parts of the world we might otherwise overlook.

The entire project is open source, and you can find the tutorial for building your own at the link in my bio.
